general.notes: Datasheet title part L9-SC31551G-20PPI (Industrial): Order Information row specifies 1310nm FP Tx, PIN Rx, -40~85°C, 20km, Simplex SC, 3.3V, LVPECL TX/RX. Optical/electrical tables are shared across order variants; central wavelength rows are noted 1310 FP vs 1550 DFB. Launch optical power, sensitivity, and maximum input power rows are noted 20km. Recommended operating data rate B is 10–1500 Mbps (typ 1250 Mbps). Operating case temperature table lists Standard 0 to +70°C (note 1) and Industrial -40 to +85°C (note 2); PPI suffix aligns with Industrial row in Order Information. Supply current Icc max 210 mA; no electrical power in watts stated. Signal Detect Range -38 to -23 dBm; SD PECL or TTL depending on order code.
